item.title: BMW, Toyota, Bosch and Repsol launch real-world trial of 100 per cent renewable petrol
item.description: Bosch, BMW, Toyota and Repsol have launched a six-month trial of 100 per cent renewable petrol, aiming to prove existing petrol engines can cut emissions without major changes.

item.title: Independent Garage Association call for first MOT fee increase in 16 years – could motorcycle MOTs rise too?
item.description: The IGA says the current MOT fee cap is no longer sustainable after 16 years without an increase. Motorcycle MOTs may also be caught up in any future review.

item.title: Triumph teams up with Silverstone for instructor-led track day experience
item.description: Triumph has partnered with Silverstone Bike Track Days to offer instructor-led demonstrations of its latest Street Triple and Speed Triple models throughout the 2026 season.

item.title: New Vespa x Gigi limited-edition Primavera 125 revealed in Saint-Tropez
item.description: Vespa has partnered with Italian restaurant Gigi Rigolatto, leading to the production of 100 limited-edition Primavera 125 scooters.

item.title: Honda signs Moto2 star David Alonso to multi-year MotoGP contract
